impacts.text: leading to complete market takeover and economic destruction
This allows the attacker to mint exactly 2^96 tokens, which is approximately 79,228,162,514,264,337,593,543,950,336  an astronomical amount that completely breaks the market economics.
An attacker can completely take over any small market with a single transaction, gaining near-total ownership (99%+) of all synthetic tokens.
This breaks the fundamental economic model where markets should have distributed ownership and fair price discovery.
The attack dilutes existing holders to near-zero value while giving the attacker control over market pricing and future liquidity.

Since small markets are common during protocol launch or when new assets are added, this represents a systemic threat that could be exploited repeatedly across multiple markets, effectively allowing attackers to monopolize entire asset categories within the protocol.
